methodology.caveman_rule: Caveman is opt-in benchmark provenance only and is not a runtime arm or chosen format
methodology.effective_cost_rule: payload + handle already in payload + unamortized ABI counted once; Human uses the comparable Human envelope
methodology.ranking_rule: TokenSaverBestOfThreeSelector: gates before cost, unique strict minimum below Human; Human on tie/error/absent counter/uncertainty
methodology.rcs1_rule: RCS1 is RemoteCodeCompactSpan.encode(canonical Human); never encode(RCW1)
methodology.rcw1_rule: RCW1 is derived from the same Human, never from RCS1

request.build_command: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOENV=off GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOFLAGS='' go -C <SOURCE> build -mod=readonly -trimpath -o <OUTPUT> ./engine/cmd/caveman-engine
